newsitem.title: UK: BMW eyeing Vickers' Rolls-Royce - paper.
newsitem.headline: BMW eyeing Vickers' Rolls-Royce - paper.

text.p: German car giant Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG (BMW) has held talks with Vickers Plc about buying the British company's Rolls-Royce luxury car unit, the Daily Mail reported on Thursday.
However, the newspaper said Vickers officials had insisted Rolls-Royce was not for sale. BMW declined to comment on the unsourced report.
The Daily Mail said Rolls-Royce chief executive Chris Woodwark met BMW director Walter Hasselkus in Britain on Monday.
No details of the discussions were revealed, it said.
"Rolls-Royce is not for sale," Woodwark told the paper, adding that the visit by Hasselkus had been arranged some months ago.
The two companies have an existing relationship, with BMW providing engines for the new generation of Bentleys and Rolls-Royces, the paper said.
Vickers could not be reached immediately for comment.
